== Helm ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you a helm if you bring him an [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Helmet]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Coral]].

== Breastplate ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you a breastplate if you bring him an [[Ancient Tarnished Breastplate]] and three [[Flawless Diamond]]s.

== Armplates ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you some armplates if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Vambraces]] and three [[Flawed Emerald]]s. 

== Bracer ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you some bracers if you bring him an [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Bracelet]] and three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s.

== Gauntlets ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you some gauntlets if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Gauntlets]] as well as three [[Crushed Topaz]]. 

== Greaves ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you some greaves if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Greaves]] and three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s.

== Boots ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Barlek promises to make you some boots if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Tarnished Plate Boots]] and a set of three [[Crushed Black Marble]] pieces.
